evidence.content:
Fleet telemetry summary FLT-101 (last 4 hours):
- Fleet navigation_error_rate: 18.2% (3/8 devices affected)
- Affected devices: DEV-401 (47.3%), DEV-402 (12.1%), DEV-403 (8.7%)
- Healthy devices: DEV-404-408 (all <0.5%, still on v3.2.1)
- Pattern: Only devices updated to v3.3.0 showing errors
- Deployment DEPL-501 started at 12:00 UTC, reached devices at 13:25 UTC
CORRELATION: Error onset directly correlates with v3.3.0 activation per device.
Path planning module crash when encountering unexpected obstacles near loading docks. Workaround: increased obstacle detection radius. Permanent fix in v3.2.0.

Telemetry snapshot DEV-401 (last 4 hours):
- navigation_error_rate: 47.3% (baseline: 0.2%, threshold: 5%)
- path_planning_failures: 142 (was 0-2 per hour)
- sensor_fusion_latency_ms: 234ms (baseline: 45ms)
- position_estimation_accuracy: 2.1m (baseline: 0.3m)
- battery_level: 78%
- uptime_since_restart: 2h 15m
- last_successful_navigation: 13:45 UTC
ANOMALY: Navigation error rate began climbing at 13:30 UTC, coinciding with v3.3.0 deployment reaching this device.

Customer reported shipment delays due to device navigation issues at Portland DC. SLA impact: 3 missed delivery windows. Root cause: navigation stack memory leak causing gradual degradation over 48-hour uptime.

Deployment manifest DEPL-501:
- Target: Fleet FLT-101 (Warehouse Alpha)
- Software: v3.3.0 (SWREV-302)
- Previous: v3.2.1 (SWREV-301)
- Started: 2026-05-06 12:00 UTC
- Strategy: Rolling update, 2 devices at a time
- Phase 1: DEV-401, DEV-402 updated at 13:25 UTC
- Phase 2: DEV-403 updated at 13:28 UTC
- Phase 3: DEV-404, DEV-405 (pending, halted due to errors)
- Status: HALTED — navigation errors detected on updated devices
Changes in v3.3.0: New navigation engine, updated sensor fusion parameters, revised path planning algorithm.
Intermittent navigation errors on DEV-401 and DEV-402. Devices losing position estimation in high-traffic warehouse corridors. Related to sensor fusion latency.

Navigation path planning failures after v3.1.2 update on Warehouse Alpha fleet. Symptoms: devices reporting NAV_PATH_PLAN_FAILED error. Resolution: rollback to v3.1.1 and patch navigation config. Root cause: sensor fusion timeout parameter too aggressive for warehouse environments with metal shelving.

Runbook: Fleet-Wide Software Rollback
1. Confirm affected devices and software version
2. Halt deployment if in progress
3. Rollback command: fleet-deploy --rollback --fleet=FLT-101 --to=PREVIOUS
4. Monitor error rates for 30 minutes post-rollback
5. Verify all devices report active status
6. Document incident and update deployment checklist

Runbook: Navigation Troubleshooting
1. Check device software version (cmd: device-info --version)
2. Review navigation error logs (cmd: logs --filter=nav --last=1h)
3. Verify sensor fusion status (cmd: sensor-status --all)
4. If error rate > 5%, check for recent deployments
5. If post-deployment, consider rollback to previous version
6. Escalate to navigation team if rollback doesn't resolve
Common causes: sensor fusion timeout, path planning parameter mismatch, map data corruption after update.

Runbook: Device Blocked Response Protocol
1. Acknowledge device blocked event within 5 minutes
2. Check device telemetry for error patterns
3. If single device: attempt remote restart
4. If multiple devices: investigate fleet-wide cause
5. Notify site operations manager if shipment impact expected
6. For enterprise accounts: prepare customer briefing within 30 minutes
Fleet-wide navigation degradation reported after software update. Error rate spike from baseline 0.2% to 15%. Affected 4 of 8 devices. Rollback resolved.
